name: Nestback
summary: A homebuying landing page with a cash-back calculator and homes that follow your budget
about: A cheerful one-page site for a homebuying, real-estate or mortgage brand. A drawn house builds itself and puffs coins from the chimney, the calculator turns a home price and agent commission into a cash-back figure with a growing coin stack, and the homes below filter to the chosen budget. A scroll-drawn how-it-works line, FAQ and text-me form round it off.
how: The house assembles itself: foundation, walls, a bouncing roof, lit windows, then coins pop out of the chimney; tap it for more
Drag the price slider or type a price in lakh, then pick the agent commission
The cash back counts up, coins drop onto the stack and the breakdown and bars update; switch on the home loan for a bigger share
Homes you can buy shows only homes within that price, each with its own cash back; Use this price sends one back to the calculator
Scroll down to watch the how-it-works line draw itself and light each step, then open the questions
Enter a mobile number in the text-me form to get the estimate; it checks the number, sends and resets
